rule: No H1-H8 gate or readiness may transition from blocked unless OneCompany explicitly authorizes that transition through a trusted OneCompany authority reference, authority identifier, reviewer identity, and reviewed target-specific evidence bound to the exact target state. Evidence reviewed or authorized only by a non-OneCompany authority cannot clear a gate or readiness. Unknown, incomplete, untrusted, or stale authority/evidence fails closed. This artifact grants no mutation, lease, deployment, merge, budget, or autonomy authority.
